hints.title: Modulo Arithmetic
hints.text: Two durations form a complete day if (hours[i] + hours[j]) % 24 == 0.

hints.title: Remainder Frequencies
hints.text: For each hour h, calculate rem = h % 24 and complement = (24 - rem) % 24.

hints.title: Running Count
hints.text: Add the frequency of complement to total valid pairs, then increment frequency of rem.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def countCompleteDayPairs(self, hours: list[int]) -> int:
        cnt = [0] * 24
        ans = 0
        for h in hours:
            rem = h % 24
            comp = (24 - rem) % 24
            ans += cnt[comp]
            cnt[rem] += 1
        return ans
```

complexity.notes: Remainder frequencies stored in fixed size 24 array.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Not applicable; linear pass is optimal.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) extra space with 24-bucket frequency array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use remainder complements and single pass frequency hash map.
